services.name: Sunset Sailing
services.desc: As the sun sets and the city lights begin to sparkle, Lake Michigan takes on an entirely different character. A private moonlit sailing charter aboard Peony offers a peaceful and unforgettable way to experience Chicago’s iconic skyline beneath the stars. Whether you’re enjoying a quiet evening together, celebrating a special occasion, or simply looking for a unique nighttime activity in Chicago, a moonlit sail combines the serenity of authentic sailing with breathtaking views of the illuminated skyline. Away from the crowds and the noise of the city, you’ll experience Lake Michigan in its most peaceful and captivating setting. Departing from Burnham Harbor with complimentary harbor parking,

services.name: Private Charter
